questions.text: Which interest list does 8 use? Onboarding shows 14 broad words, the Profile page uses finer groups.
questions.decision: The 14 onboarding words for now. The Profile page will match them.

questions.text: Can Continue on 8 go with nothing picked?
questions.decision: Continue works with nothing picked. Plans stay generic, like Skip.

questions.text: Email sign-in: password, or a code sent to the email? Pick one before N1·2 is designed.
Is there a quiz? A7·1 offers Take the quiz, but nothing is designed behind it.
questions.decision: The quiz comes after MVP. For MVP, A7·1 shows only Save these.

questions.text: A returning account on a new phone: skip onboarding, or still ask for location and alerts?
questions.decision: A returning account on a new phone skips onboarding but is asked for location and alerts.

questions.text: If the app closes mid-onboarding, which steps pick up where they were?
questions.decision: Closed mid-onboarding: it starts again from 1.

questions.text: Does a link that is reading take over the top? Chapter D says no, J3 shows yes. Rows 2 and 3 use J3 as a what-if.
Paste: iOS asks "Allow Paste" every time unless Argo uses the system Paste button. Check with the developers.
